requirement.clarified: Fix the visual layer of unified viewer/editor drag-and-drop. Prior cycle wired events + POST /api/save but the rendered Timeline/Kanban slot card never updates because mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay flips a .selected flag instead of replacing card content. Sidebar isSelected ✓ tracker is correct but stalls because effectiveDay never reflects the selection. CSS rules for .slot-drop drop-active/reject states are missing entirely. Yunnan trip is the only data file in scope; all other trip data and schemas remain byte-identical. v2: merge signature expanded to 4-arg to receive editorTripData for cross-day fallback; precedence-ordered findSelectedOption helper; prefer PLAN-alternative card content over v2 synthesis (codex F7 currency); seed accommodation-1-2 with data: URI into Day 1 to make AC9 verifiable; Timeline becomes a drop target (RC-11); S1 promoted to MUST; ACs use Chinese name_local substrings with positive+negative assertions; AC12 baseline pinned to pre-cycle SHA 9218b6bd.
requirement.what: Rewrite mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay with EXPANDED 4-arg signature (publishedDay, editorDay, editorSelections, editorTripData). REPLACE rendered slot card content (name, location, image, cost, time, notes, option_id) preferring an existing PLAN_DATA alternative card matched by option_id (codex F7); synthesize from v2 only when no PLAN alternative exists (e.g. seeded accommodation-1-2). Preserve existing time when v2 option omits it; filter duplicates; treat day.accommodation as an object. Add inline <style> block with rules for .slot-drop[data-drop-active] / [data-drop-reject] / [data-drop-success] (flash also on stable slot card per codex F9). Add data-slot-card='primary'|'alternative', data-slot-id, data-option-id (when selected), data-timeline-entry, data-day-cover attributes on rendered cards (S1 promoted to MUST per RC-6). Make Timeline entries drop targets (AC13 RC-11) using entry._slotId not _type. Seed accommodation-1-2 into Day 1 with data:image/svg+xml;base64,... cover URI (R1c v2 + RC-2 + codex F2).
requirement.why: User reports drag fires but visual layer never updates. Prior QA verified source code only and missed the data-vs-event-handler gap. Root cause: merge() never propagates option content into the data the view reads.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: User drags a sidebar candidate onto a Timeline/Kanban slot; events fire correctly and POST /api/save returns 200, but the visible slot card content does not change. Sidebar ✓ also fails to move (because React doesn't re-render the candidate list — the effectiveDay output is identical to before, so the useMemo skips re-evaluation).
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (scripts/lib/react_template.tpl:1889-1972) only sets card.selected=true when the selected option's name matches an existing PLAN_DATA card's name_base or name_local. It never copies the selected option's content into the card. KanbanView (L843-887) and TimelineView (L1504) read name_base/image/cost/time directly from day.meals[slotId] / day.attractions / day.entertainment — fields that merge() leaves untouched. The data layer is the missing bridge between the editor_selections state map and the rendered DOM. Additional defects: (a) accommodation branch uses Array.isArray on an object (L1915, dead code); (b) no CSS rules exist for the .slot-drop[data-drop-active] / [data-drop-reject] attributes set by the event handlers; (c) the inline 'background: transparent' on slot-drop overlays would override any plain CSS rule by specificity.

development_approach.strategy: 1) Rewrite mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay to perform per-slot content replacement using a v2-to-PLAN field-mapping helper. Lookup by option_id (not name). For meal: replace day.meals[slotId] with {...existingCard, ...mappedFromV2, option_id, selected:true}; filter the same option_id out of day.meal_alternatives[slotId]. For activity: find matching card across attractions/entertainment/cafe/unscheduled_optionals by ANY option in editorDay.slots[slotId].options (prefer card with time); replace in place; remove other appearances by option_id. For accommodation: treat day.accommodation as object; replace fields; update day.cover from cover_image||image. Preserve key-presence semantics (key absent = persistedId; key present + null = no replace). 2) Add a top-level inline <style> block injected via React's <style> tag at App return. CSS rules use outline + box-shadow (which are not set inline) for drop-active, animation-name for drop-reject + drop-success, with !important fallback if needed. 3) Tag rendered slot cards with data-slot-card, data-slot-id, and data-option-id (when selected) for AC selector stability. 4) Align applyBridge + board-to-board onDrop with the existing drop-bridge cross-meal copy.
development_approach.validation_approach: Live Playwright session at /trip/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 with desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844: (a) DOM textContent assertions on data-slot-card / data-slot-id locators after simulated drag chains; (b) getComputedStyle on .slot-drop[data-drop-active|reject|success]; (c) screenshot diff against pre-cycle build for backward-compat AC7; (d) git diff stat for AC12 file-scope. /api/save POST 200 by itself is NOT acceptable evidence.

research_findings.reason: Bug is a localized data-transformation defect in an established React/v2 schema we already understand; no industry pattern lookup adds value.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex returned 12 numbered findings. 2 blockers (Findings 1, 2 — v2-to-PLAN mapping under-specified + activity replacement must prefer timed card and remove duplicates), 5 major (Findings 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10 — meal_alternatives duplicate, deselect ambiguity, source-slot self-write in bridge, inline-style specificity, accommodation Array.isArray dead code, byte-identity AC over-claim, DOM hooks needed), 4 observation_only (Findings 8, 11, 12, plus deselect aspects). All blockers and major findings incorporated into R1/R1a/R1b/R1c/R3/S1/S2 and the AC bodies.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 1 — selOpt-derived content under-specified; v2 options use name/location_summary/cost/time=None/image=None.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a synthesis helper that maps v2->PLAN shape, preserves target-slot time, falls back to existing image, sets name_base/location_base/cost_local, converts/infers display cost.
findings.rationale: Captured verbatim in the Reference Source field-mapping rule and in R1 of the spec; AC1/AC2/AC3 assert visible-text contains the synthesized values.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 2 — Activity replacement must prefer timed card and remove duplicates.
findings.proposed_fix: For each activity slot, find existing card matching ANY option in the slot, prefer the timed card, replace in place preserving the slot time, and remove duplicate selected-option cards from other arrays.
findings.rationale: Captured as R1b in the spec; AC3 asserts time preservation and AC3 last bullet asserts no duplicates.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 3 — Meal alternatives can duplicate after R1 replaces day.meals[dinner].
findings.proposed_fix: After replacing day.meals[slotId], filter the selected option out of day.meal_alternatives[slotId] by option_id.
findings.rationale: Captured as R1a in the spec; AC1 last bullet asserts no duplicate cards bearing the selected option's text.

findings.proposed_fix: Either exclude deselect from this cycle, or render empty/required placeholder for explicit-null.
findings.rationale: Explicitly deferred to out_of_scope_observations and to Won't Have. R1 only replaces when selectedId is non-null; null cases keep the PLAN_DATA card visible (intentional for THIS cycle).

findings.issue: Codex Finding 5 — Bridge sets editorSelections[originSlotId] = optionId for cross-meal compatible drops; with R1 the source slot will also visibly change.
findings.proposed_fix: Stop setting [originSlotId]: optionId for candidate-to-slot cross-meal selection unless origin equals target; have merge resolve meal option_id across all meal slots.
findings.rationale: Captured as S2 in the spec; out_of_scope_observations records the deeper UX question. AC8 accepts either S2-aligned behavior or the deferred state.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 6 — Inline 'background: transparent' on .slot-drop will beat plain CSS attribute selectors by specificity.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove inline background, OR use !important, OR use outline / box-shadow instead. Use attribute-backed data-drop-success for state.
findings.rationale: Captured as R3 with explicit dev guidance; AC10 accepts any of outline / background / box-shadow as proof, giving dev choice.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 7 — day.accommodation is an object but merge L1915 checks Array.isArray (dead code).
findings.proposed_fix: Replace day.accommodation as object; preserve/update day.cover only when option has cover_image/image.
findings.rationale: Captured as R1c in the spec; AC9 verifies.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 8 — Budget/route are not fully safe as visual ACs.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep them out of this cycle's pass/fail unless explicitly fixed.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 9 — Byte-identity AC needs tightening; HTML byte-identity impossible since template changes globally; persisted selected_option_id differing from PLAN_DATA conflicts with 'unedited default render'.
findings.proposed_fix: Use file-diff ACs for data files only; for render use DOM/screenshot equivalence, not HTML byte identity.
findings.rationale: AC7 reworded to require DOM textContent equivalence (not HTML byte identity) and pixel-diff with RMSE tolerance. AC12 covers the file-diff scope (data + scripts).

findings.issue: Codex Finding 10 — AC template should add data-slot-card, data-slot-id, data-option-id hooks on rendered cards.
findings.proposed_fix: Add harmless data-* attributes; ACs assert live Playwright DOM text, computed style, file byte-diff; avoid 'POST 200' / source-string checks.
findings.rationale: Captured as S1 in the spec; AC1/AC2/AC3 reference [data-slot-card][data-slot-id] selectors and [data-option-id].
